scholarships.name: University Summer Courses offered in Germany for Foreign Students and Graduates **• DAAD**
scholarships.description: The aim of this programme is to deepen the knowledge of the German language, both in general language and technical language and to augment the knowledge of the regional studies.
scholarships.deadlineText: **30 October of each year, 23:59 (Central European Time). Applications are possible from 01 September each year**
scholarships.sourceQuote: Applications are open to students and graduates in any subject area. Undergraduate students (e.g. Bachelor’s) must have completed at least two academic years of university study **by the time the funding period begins**. eligibility.textValue: Students who are in their final year of higher education at the time of application are only eligible to apply if they intend to undertake postgraduate studies immediately after graduating.

eligibility.textValue: The grant holder must be at least 18 years old when starting the language course.

eligibility.textValue: Applicants must be enrolled at a university in one of the programme-related countries (except Germany) both at the time of application and throughout the entire scholarship period.
eligibility.sourceQuote: Applicants must be enrolled at a university in one of the programme-related countries (except Germany) both at the time of application and throughout the entire scholarship period.

eligibility.textValue: Applicants must be able to follow lectures in German and participate in group work.
eligibility.sourceQuote: Applicants must be able to follow lectures in German and participate in group work.

eligibility.textValue: German language skills must be proven at the time of application.

eligibility.textValue: The language certificate cannot be older than one year at the time of application (this also applies to DSH).

eligibility.textValue: Language certificates from B2 or TDN3 in all examination parts of the exam may be up to two years old.
